set.body:
Outcome

Turn the constitutional laws into the durable cross-platform assurance court.

Acceptance

- Generators cover axes, invalid owners, multiplicity, degeneracy, rank deficiency, non-finite inputs, ill-conditioning, failures, and execution variants.
- Shrinkers retain scientifically useful invariants.
- Expensive properties use stable seeds and bounded workers.
- Laws target public interfaces and deliberately broken implementations fail.
set.title: P7.1: complete generated public laws and hostile-domain generators
